title: Khalsa Resolve Hardens Before the Counterattack

blocks.text: The Singhs now say openly that Had they given a chase to the fleeing Mughal troops the enemy might have been broken beyond recovery instead of merely scattered.

Yet the setback becomes fuel for a larger gathering, because when ten Singhs died, twenty more arrived, and as their strength increased to one thousand the Khalsa prepared for a much sharper return blow.

They move with stripped-down resolve, either to eliminate the Mughals or sacrifice their own lives, invoking blessings of Guru Gobind Singh before advancing toward the enemy camping at the place of Bhilowal.
